name: Imouto to Sono Yuujin ga Ero Sugite Ore no Kokan ga Yabai
original_name: 妹とその友人がエロすぎて俺の股間がヤバイ
source: After becoming a tutor for his sister Miu and her friend Riko, Kanata quickly discovers that he is much more popular than he makes himself out to be.
translation: 在給妹妹海羽和她的朋友莉子當上家教後，彼方很快發現，原來自己遠比想像中更受歡迎。
